item.message: Skill descriptions were shortened to fit the skills context budget. Codex can still see every skill, but some descriptions are shorter. Disable unused skills or plugins to leave more room for the rest.

item.text: {"item_id":"feed:https://mit-cdfg.github.io/Survey-AI-for-3D-modeling-Robotics/#view-stats","version_id":"08b1c2cdebb5796d7332d57e8928784a621aec9f82db91448016eaa53ea51fe5","decision":"accept","reason":"This is fresh, directly relevant survey evidence on editable 3D scenes, parametric CAD, and simulation-based robotics, with a clear perspective on what engineering checks remain absent. Its stated review of 1,646 public posts across 707 cases and checks against available code, videos, and documentation supports use as a map of reported evidence, while the passage also discloses that only 132 cases have runnable code. The numerical CAD and robotics results remain benchmark- or source-specific claims rather than proof of manufacturability or physical transfer: tolerances, physical-part manufacturability, withheld-condition robustness, and precise contact tasks were not adequately checked. It can frame what changed, scrutinize the gap between valid/editable outputs and engineering validation, and inform builders about verification work to watch next.","piece_ids":["01","02","03"]}
